concept.interaction: Two to five players each choose one of two boats and one unused -1, 0 or +1 choice-cards direction. Sum directions separately for the two starting carriers, turn both, and carry every boat. Selected boats share each fixed harbor reward across both carriers with integer rounding down; unselected boats do not dilute it. Selected boats then cross to the other carrier and drift one harbor clockwise using one scoring snapshot. After three rounds refill directions. Record twelve rounds on the score-sheet. The tactile signature is collective carrier movement transporting opponents while shared landing rewards and lane crossing reverse the next decision.
limitations: Physical printing, fit, tactile quality and human enjoyment remain untested.
Simulation is software evidence, not human playtesting; five-player synchronized policies expose a documented unresolved policy balance concern.
Six- and eighteen-round variants are specified but not separately simulated.

concept.summary: A simultaneous family game where everyone steers the same two currents. Carry rival boats, crowd valuable harbors, then cross into tomorrow’s current.
concept.title: Crosscurrent
